review_method: Independent direct readback of saved plan, sessions, raw envelopes, collection receipts and per-attempt execution records; source implementation inspection. No candidate, detector, fit, predict, collection or digest recomputation.

CONTROLLED_TARGET_INTERVENTION_ACTIVE.interpretation: 3 cdp_webdriver_only_v1 and 3 stealth_languages_only_v1 active sessions, with independent execution/session matching and observed declared field change. Supports a controlled target-manipulation activity label only.

PAIRED_BASELINE_OR_RESTORATION.interpretation: clean_pre and clean_post around the six target interventions; direct-launch source path, target observation restoration verified.

ADDITIONAL_LOCAL_CONTROL.interpretation: 9 no-attack temporal controls and 3 debug-transport triplet records; only middle debug record uses no-injection CDP attach/navigation.

SMOKE_ONLY.interpretation: Exclude from training and scored denominators; collector acceptance smoke only.

label_admission_policy.requirements: Keep task-specific activity labels in evaluation metadata. Do not infer ground truth from a candidate relation or classifier outcome. Do not upgrade any baseline/control to population benign truth.

grouping_recommendation.minimum_no_split_unit: all 31 records share one environment/install and must not straddle train/test folds
grouping_recommendation.limits: A held-out environment with only one new collection environment cannot yield a new-data-only cross-environment training/evaluation split.

language.quality_derivation: Reuse manipulation_eval.adapter.quality_for after ordinary type/status validation; observed nonmissing language values are observed_value. Preserve status and list order. Quality is not a collector-supplied field.
language.source_semantics: Same synchronous getNavigatorFeatures call with cached nav object; not an atomic read or proof of native getter authenticity.

webdriver_raw.copy_policy: Copy only the seven required members without filling, coercing or collapsing false/null/absent/error. Preserve missing members for later U/FAILED handling.
webdriver_raw.source_semantics: Presence and value are separate observations of the same cached navigator object; getter once when present. Association is not authenticity and raw false is only a reported false.

source_registration_recommendation.reader_revision_placement: Preparation registry metadata only; it is not a SourceBinding constructor field. The observer_revision is app-webdriver-observer-v1.
source_registration_recommendation.per_session_binding_rule: Generate caller-owned registration from the reviewed manifest, plan, raw archive offset, receipt and attempt join; compare page metadata to registered observer and realm. Never construct trust from page realm metadata alone.
source_registration_recommendation.existing_registration_constructor: make_source_binding requires modes[MODE].source_status=SUPPORTED_BY_EXISTING_LINEAGE, nonempty evidence_refs, matching binding_scope, and source_group_id.

limitations: The registered protocol scope was local collection acceptance, not a pre-frozen formal training dataset; future admission must be declared explicitly and separately.
Only one emulator environment and one install; no physical device or independent confirmation material. Repeats are not independent devices.
The languages injection changes both first item and list length. These three positives cannot distinguish the new first-item condition from the historical length condition.
No normal multi-language App cases, API-absence cases, getter-error cases or nonboolean webdriver observations occur in these 31 records.
No-injection CDP control does not reproduce all Puppeteer internal behavior; the checked stability claim concerns the two target observations, not all 177 fields.
Do not backfill historical strict-true-projection false values into raw false; keep historical and new observation modes separate.
No generalized attack truth, population FPR, training benefit or overall detection-rate change was measured.
No formal binary label, candidate evaluation, model training or prediction was performed by this review.

app177_base_input_structural_check.scope: Pure App177 conversion and structural coverage only. No detector or predicate measurement performed.

w0_base_atom_construction_review.required_field_status_quality: All 1178 required field observations have observed / observed_value; availability under predicate-specific domains was not evaluated.

legacy_cache_entry_point.reason: Only repackages existing fixed R02 matrices and sidecars keyed by historical opaque IDs. It performs no raw extraction and has no input parameter for newly admitted records.

reusable_stateless_primitives.purpose: Measure each of the 5 exact catalog definitions from the adapted current payload, with original polarity and U/FAILED rules. No cached historical result can be substituted for a new record.
Mask to app_web67, use fixed parser/typed-state interpretation. Form 16 fixed equality cells using the frozen equals values; preserve 27 raw numeric/list-length controls without fitting thresholds.

existing_combined_entry.reason: Its source reads frozen metadata and computes W0 plus all selectable core catalog atoms for C0 structural probes. The enclosing c_probes.run loads models and predicts, so run is out of scope. Do not use a probe-scoped runner as the new dataset admission runner.

w0_base_atom_construction_review.required_new_integration: Add an exact-allowlist new-data measurement wrapper using the existing primitives, carrying the new source/data index and separate evaluation metadata. It must assert exact 48 base input atom keys for W0, then apply the separately frozen rule-semantics variant adjustment. Never call cache_rows to pretend the new records are historical cache rows.
w0_base_atom_construction_review.numeric_boundary: Threshold estimation is a fit operation. Keep UNFITTED_CONTROL values raw now; later fit thresholds only on each explicitly registered own-train partition.
w0_base_atom_construction_review.readiness: App177 structural coverage PASS; W0 base cell measurement and new-data runner integration NOT_EXECUTED and still required before a formal retraining dispatch.
